identity: All eight frozen file hashes match freeze and live worktree; all 201 sources.json sourceSha256 pins match.

findings.title: Admitted driver never executes a financial case
findings.evidence: After constructing providers, every accepted input returns admitted-not-executed. No deployment, initialization, financial call, Generated.ledger readback, token-color comparison, or oracle invocation exists. Root deployment-sentinel test records zero calls.
findings.repair: Implement deploy -> initialize -> accrue/settle or swap/close with observed constructor/stage baselines and failure stops; require both orders in offline transport tests.

findings.title: Production receipt decoder has no successful byte path
findings.evidence: Successful deserialize/serialize is followed by an unconditional throw. No offer enumeration, signature/address association, mint/balance extraction, metadata/identifier reconciliation or real public-state decode follows. Hash equality after re-deserialization is not equality of input bytes with canonical serialization.
findings.repair: Implement the approved finalized-byte decoding and reconciliation. Keep absent positive proven-byte fixtures as a separate coverage gap, not a runtime prohibition.

findings.title: Receipt acceptance trusts flags and uncontrolled object spread
findings.evidence: Root controls show a contract/block/acceptedStage-only object validates and publicState overwrites FailEntirely with SucceedEntirely. Reviewer control confirms an unknown nested private canary in publicState is copied to output. Missing arrays, finality/version evidence and unknown fields are not rejected.
findings.repair: Closed allowlisted nested schema; derive success solely from reconciled finalized evidence; reject absent fields and unknown provenance; never spread caller objects into public receipts.

findings.title: Oracle fills observations from expected fixtures and ignores financial mutations
findings.evidence: Both projections clone the expected fixture and replace selected leaves; provenance maps are incomplete and sourceSha256/metadataSha256 are unused. Reviewer mutations missing accrue principal_paid, setup principal_due=999, wrong transfer color/payee, and missing transfers/minted/identifiers each still pass receipt validator and comparator. principal_paid explicitly defaults to zero at line 225.
findings.repair: Build financial leaves from required observations and verified source bytes; cover every projection leaf with checked provenance; independently validate actual colors/owners/effects and all state/result fields. Add these mutation controls.

findings.title: Providers do not satisfy pinned SDK construction/submission interfaces
findings.evidence: Pinned levelPrivateStateProvider index.mjs:751-759 requires privateStoragePasswordProvider and accountId; neither is supplied, so the production constructor throws. privateStateStorePath is not its database-location option (midnightDbName is). Returned providers omit walletProvider and midnightProvider required by contracts index.mjs:28-29,997. ZK provider receives private-state location rather than proven compiled assets.
findings.repair: Wire actual scoped storage/password and proven-asset APIs plus walletProvider and wrapped midnightProvider; test compatibility against pinned signatures without starting transport.

findings.title: Funding checks do not bind complete effects or enforce actual gross allowance
findings.evidence: Reviewer pure-helper counterexample changes a fallible output value/owner and adds a finalized intent; recheck still returns ok. It checks only base intents and guaranteed outputs, skipping balancing intents, fallible outputs and extra segments. Gross computation only scans base segment 1; supplied allowance.grossSpend replaces computed gross with no sufficiency comparison. Wrapper counters are unused.
findings.repair: Compare complete approved/finalized effects, preserving intent/order/signature associations and rejecting additions. Compute gross across all funding inputs and required fees, check against allowance, and reserve before every actual submit/finalize boundary.

findings.title: Deadlines, cleanup and stop-after-ambiguity are not implemented
findings.evidence: deadlineMs is destructured then returned, never enforced. Wallet/query operations directly await; no cleanup or containment/cancellation result exists. Each funding call creates a new one-use wrapper, so an ambiguous failure does not stop a subsequent call. attempts accepts NaN/Infinity/fractions and deadline accepts Infinity.
findings.repair: Enforce a shared absolute deadline and stopped state across operations, close resources on exit, retain reservations/IDs on ambiguity, and reject nonfinite/nonintegral limits before side effects.

findings.title: Builder lacks admitted full-build/output-manifest behavior and freshness checks
findings.evidence: No fullBuildAdmission/sourceManifest check, real compiler branch, or actual output/key/version hash manifest exists. The adapter recursively stages into existing output. Source-pass invocation prohibition does not remove admitted implementation requirements.
findings.repair: Implement gated real compile and actual asset/version validation while keeping source tests adapter-only; reject existing output and symlink ancestors before staging. Do not run a full compile under this review.

verification.inspected: Six owned files, both reports, packet/sources, root verification, selected pinned SDK sources.
verification.rootEvidence: Existing root receipts inspected: supplied 27/27 pass; three behavioral requirements fail. Suite not rerun by reviewer.
verification.independent: Offline helper/projection controls reproduced erroneous acceptance in R3/R4/R6 (exit 0).
verification.limits: No network, provider launch, wallet, proof, compiler, ledger settlement or positive finalized-byte fixture. No raw worker/provider reasoning read. Reports alone were written; source unchanged.

disposition: Repair approved behavior within source scope; no new design packet needed. Source/ledger acceptance, PCD and SP05 remain unestablished.
